description: Turns off every share link (site_share_link) and every signed-in preview of the Development site at once, the way the dashboard's "Turn off every preview link" does: anyone holding an old link can't open the preview any more. The site's files and the version it serves don't change; the founder opens it again from the dashboard, and site_share_link makes new links. Development only — the Live site is public and has no preview links. Development caps how many a day. On the founder's Logs.
name: site_revoke_previews
title: Turn off every preview link
